cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
Usually the `OFF` mode means that even if the temperature drops, it would not start heating. If it is on a `HEAT` mode but not currently heating, then the ACTION should be `IDLE`, but mode should still be `HEAT`.

if we don't have a way to set mode, maybe we should set it to HEAT only, and keep it fixed.
